components.text: The Incense Altar is a multiblock structure that can be used to boost your self-sacrificing at a Blood Altar. By standing near your setup, the Incense Altar will calm your soul based on the area's total Tranquility, allowing you to significantly increase your $(blood)LP$() gains.

The basic Tier 1 setup is the Altar itself - place it down anywhere and stay within a 5 block radius of it. While working, it will emit flame particles from its top and transform your Sacrificial Knife. Once your knife starts to shine, holding and releasing right-click near a Blood Altar will sacrifice 90% of your health all at once.

Based on the total Tranquility of the area, you'll receive a bonus to the $(blood)LP$() added to the Blood Altar. Hovering over the Incense Altar with a Divination Sigil or Seer's Sigil will display the total Tranquility of the setup and the percentage bonus received when sacrificing.

Paths of different materials extend the Incense Altar's range: wooden paths reach three rings out from the centre, stone paths up to five rings, worn stone paths seven rings, and obsidian paths nine rings. Not every block counts toward Tranquility - the relevant categories are Plants, Crops, Trees, Earthen, Water, Fire, and Lava (specific examples include Lava, Water, Life Essence, Netherrack, Dirt, Farmland, Potatoes, Carrots, Wheat, Nether Wart, Beetroots, Leaves, Logs, Fire, and Grass).

The total Tranquility is calculated by square-rooting the Tranquility of each type present and adding the results together - so for later-game setups, it's best to have many different types of Tranquility rather than a huge amount of just one.
The Tranquility bonus is capped by the size of your Altar (i.e. tier of path used): No Path 20%, Wooden Path 60%, Stone Path 120%, Worn Stone Path 200%, Obsidian Path 300%.
